subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.description: Direct your Rage primarily toward violence and untrammeled fury.

subclasses.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclasses.description: View yourself as kin to the animal inhabitants of the natural world.

subclasses.name: Path of the World Tree
subclasses.description: Link your Rage to the cosmic ash tree Yggdrasil for vitality and travel.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.description: Channel your Rage into dangerous religious fervor, serving as an instrument of your deity.
